kjv: on the other side of the flood
note: Hannahar is "the River", i.e. the Euphrates (Mesopotamia); "flood" (1611 for a large river) now suggests Noah's flood. Same in vv.3, 14, 15.

kjv: under an oak, that [was] by the sanctuary
mine: under the oak that was in the sanctuary
note: Bemiqdash YHWH is "in the sanctuary"; the KJV softens to "by", perhaps to avoid a tree inside a holy place (cf. Deut 16:21). The article (ha'allah) marks a known oak (cf. Gen 35:4).
Qesitah is an old unit of value of unknown weight (also Gen 33:19, Job 42:11); silver is not named in the Hebrew.

kjv: in a hill [that pertained to] Phinehas his (Eleazar's) son
mine: at Gibeah, the town of his (Eleazar's) son Phinehas
note: Giv'at pinechas is most naturally the place name Gibeah ("hill") of Phinehas, a town given to him; the KJV takes it as a common noun.
